coverage.destination_weight_rule: home region share * grid TIMS trips / ALL region TIMS trips
coverage.coverage_rule: minimal prefix covers >=99% of service eligible original weights; also report national share
coverage.service_rule: 60km hub road distance per grid; regions with no eligible grid excluded; regional day-trip scope assumption
coverage.resolution: TIMS 500m center; no jitter because matrix supports centers only
